trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlocks automatically the moment you own the other 54 trophies. Plan around the missable list first (see our roadmap stage 2) so a single playthrough can cover nearly everything before mopping up collectibles and activities. Source: PSNProfiles; PowerPyx

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing by following the mission markers; it is the game's tutorial hunt and cannot be failed permanently since story missions are replayable from the menu. Source: PlayStationTrophies.org; GameFAQs

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finishing every story mission of Chapter 1 pops this automatically; community trackers confirm no side content is counted toward the chapter unlock. Source: PSNProfiles; Exophase

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Auto-unlocks when Chapter 2's last mission credits roll. Keep an eye on missable side content during this chapter (Sneakthief window) before pushing on. Source: PowerPyx; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Completing all Chapter 3 missions triggers it. Nothing optional is required, but this chapter introduces several activities worth trying once for Master of None. Source: PlayStationTrophies.org; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Earned by finishing Chapter 4. Community consensus is that no collectible or side quest gates the unlock. Source: Exophase; GameFAQs

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The credits-roll trophy: beat the last story mission and it is yours. Replay from the menu if you somehow skipped it after Chapter 4. Source: PSNProfiles; PowerPyx

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: One-off story mission; finish Breakfast Run whenever it becomes available in the story. Cannot be failed permanently — it can be replayed. Source: GameFAQs; PlayStationTrophies.org

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A long heist mission late in the story; completing it unlocks the trophy. Save beforehand if you want to also practice the freeroam vault heists it teaches. Source: PowerPyx; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Simply complete the mission Child's Play when the story offers it. No rating or time target is needed for the trophy itself. Source: PSNProfiles; Exophase

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the Headliners mission. Its stage objectives are forgiving; only completion counts. Source: PlayStationTrophies.org; GameFAQs

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the airport-set story mission VCIA Takedown. Pair it with the freeroam Catch Me If You Can stunt at the same location afterwards. Source: PowerPyx; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Beat Operation Savage Glory, one of the final story missions. Auto-unlocks on completion. Source: Exophase; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Requires every story mission, all strangers' strands, all collectibles and every activity tracked by the in-game stat page. Do story first, then use the pause-menu checklist to hunt what is left. Source: PSNProfiles; PowerPyx

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Jump ramps marked on the map; 250 stunt jumps across Leonida, and the counter carries over sessions. Grind the dense Vice City cluster last for efficiency. Source: PowerPyx; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of every activity type (racing, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, yoga, etc.) — one attempt each is enough. Track which icons you have touched via the activities menu. Source: PSNProfiles; GameFAQs

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 42 Shooting Range challenges need gold medals; scores to beat are shown per challenge. Reportedly the hardest activity trophy — practice the pistol and SMG drills first. Source: PowerPyx; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win, not just finish, a drone race at each Top Fun site. AI racers are aggressive early on; learn the first corner before committing. Source: PlayStationTrophies.org; Exophase

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty wins across twenty different race events (land, sea, air all count). Difficulty scales with your vehicle class, so buy a competitive car early. Source: PowerPyx; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to fishing and out-score him; reel tension management is the whole skill. Multiple attempt chances make this low-pressure. Source: GameFAQs; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find any arcade cabinet in Vice City and finish one full game. Cheap and quick; do it during a story visit to a bar. Source: Exophase; PlayStationTrophies.org

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's stranger strand ends with this mission; the strand must be completed before the story's endgame locks some strangers out, so do it early. Source: PowerPyx; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand finale. Boat-handling missions — take it slow around mangroves to avoid restarts. Source: PSNProfiles; GameFAQs

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's biker strand's last mission. Long ride across the state; keep a fast bike nearby. Source: Exophase; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight full stranger strands (of more than ten available) — the four required for other trophies count. Marked with question-mark icons; several are missable after the story. Source: PowerPyx; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's smuggling strand finale. Do it before the point of no return — strands lock late in the story. Source: GTA Wiki; PlayStationTrophies.org

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's music-scene strand ends here. Pure story; no rating needed. Source: GameFAQs; Exophase

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find and use every meditation spot (around 12 across the state); each is a short interactive scene. Use the in-game map filter to see which remain. Source: PowerPyx; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Part of Bret's hunting strand: track and take the unique quarry he assigns. Any weapon works; the trophy is on the kill, not the score. Source: PSNProfiles; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect every card in three full sets of the collectible card game — sets have fixed card lists viewable in-game. Three full sets, not three cards. Source: PowerPyx; Exophase

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It social app action at 100 distinct marked spots across Leonida. Locations are tracked in the app UI, so grind while free-roaming. Source: PSNProfiles; PowerPyx

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: 50 completed challenges from the challenge list (stunt, combat, driving). They stack with stunt-jump progress, so chase both at once. Source: Exophase; GameFAQs

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level, then escape it with your partner AI in the party. Can be done in freeroam anytime partners are available, but community guides flag it as missable if never attempted before the endgame. Source: PowerPyx; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three stores in a row while keeping the wanted level alive between them — rob, flee a short distance, rob again. Pick three shops on one highway for clean spacing. Source: PowerPyx; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Sit in 100 different vehicle models; a discovery is logged the first time you enter each one. Car shows, valet stands and heavy traffic get you there quickly. Source: PSNProfiles; Exophase

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with five enemies close and drop all five before the meter empties. Replay any gun-heavy story mission to refill targets quickly. Source: PowerPyx; GameFAQs

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle onto the airport runway and jump a ramp out of the airport perimeter — the joke departure the description hides. Freeroam any time, though the exact ramp matters. Source: PowerPyx; PlayStationTrophies.org

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Hidden until earned: acquire a Rhino tank (military base theft works) and drive it into water or trigger its overheated engine state — community guides describe the trigger as the tank's temperature gag. Source: PSNProfiles; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Enter a jewelry store's back area unseen and take the case without alerting staff — crouch, avoid the camera cone, walk out calm. Guards restart the attempt if spotted. Source: PowerPyx; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five separate freeroam bank vault hits with a clean escape each time. They reset after a cooldown, so rotate between city vaults. Source: Exophase; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck in traffic, blow or pry the rear doors, take the cash and lose the resulting wanted level. Watch for armored trucks on the highways during the day. Source: PowerPyx; GameFAQs

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every revealed map region until the exploration stat reads 100%. Roads and marked POIs cover nearly all of it — chase the swamp and islands last. Source: PSNProfiles; PowerPyx

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation (marked compound) for each of the gangs in the endgame. Some operations unlock only after certain story chapters, so wait for all markers. Source: Exophase; GTA Forums

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Buy the specific rooftop-bar cocktail on Ocean Beach and drink it at the railing view spot. Guides note the bar's rooftop access is easy to overlook, and the bar closes during one story stretch. Source: PowerPyx; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car at speed through a showroom's front glass and out the other side. Any showroom works, but guides flag the glass respawn behavior — approach from the street straight-on. Source: PlayStationTrophies.org; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Roll a strike — literally a follow-through — at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The alley is inside a members' venue, so access first, then throw. Source: PowerPyx; Exophase

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Hidden: build your partnership's public reputation to the threshold the social feed tracks — community guides say it unlocks from repeated positive co-op actions in public spaces. Source: PSNProfiles; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Reach any major story choice point and commit to a decision; the trophy fires on the choice either way, so it cannot be lost by picking wrong. Source: PowerPyx; GameFAQs

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail and then retry a mission — the second completion after an explicit failure unlocks it. Extremely easy if you die once on purpose. Source: PSNProfiles; Exophase

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Hidden strangeness trigger, widely reported as the state-wide UFO/oddity Easter egg sequence: complete the associated oddity chain (radio signals then the site visit). Follow a written order, since the trigger has steps. Source: PowerPyx; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Hit a pedestrian (or a set of them) with a melee weapon during a drive-by — the bowling pun is the whole trophy. Any slow city street with an open window works. Source: GameFAQs; PowerPyx

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Collect Marked Bills from operations and launder $250,000 total through your contacts' laundering menu. The counter is cumulative across the game. Source: PowerPyx; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 cumulative in shops — clothes, guns, food all count. Combine with buying garage properties toward Little Boxes. Source: Exophase; GameFAQs

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every purchasable garage property on the map; the priciest run well over $100k each, so earn via laundering and heists first. Source: PowerPyx; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Use the Scooter Bros app to register 10 vehicles you acquire. Steal-then-register works, so this can be finished in one freeroam session. Source: PSNProfiles; Exophase

roadmap.title: Story playthrough, missables first
roadmap.detail: Play the story in order, but before each chapter check the missable list (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Sneakthief, In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Ten Pin, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There). Grab Trust, Break the Bank and the early stranger strands as they appear.

roadmap.title: Finish the story and strangers
roadmap.detail: Complete the remaining story missions for the chapter trophies, the final mission (You Gotta Know When to Get Off), and the eight stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks plus Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret.

roadmap.title: Vehicles, exploration and WAiNK
roadmap.detail: Free-roam: discover 100 vehicles (Whip It Good), explore all of Leonida (The Goodtime State), WAiNK 100 spots (You WAiNKer!), and register 10 vehicles via Scooter Bros.

roadmap.title: Stunts and challenges
roadmap.detail: Work through 250 stunt jumps (Cunning Stunts) while stacking 50 challenges (One Last Thing) — they overlap heavily.

roadmap.title: Activities sweep
roadmap.detail: One of each activity type (Master of None), an arcade game, a fishing duel with Cal, Top Fun races at every site, 20 race wins, and the shooting-range gold grind (The Shootist, hardest trophy).

roadmap.title: Heists, robberies and combat
roadmap.detail: Five bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal), an armored truck (A Classic Blitz Play), every gang's illegal operation (Pest Control), five enemies in one Combat Focus (Gunslinger), and the partner stunts: Hot Together and Retail Therapy.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and money
roadmap.detail: Three full card sets (Don't Touch My Deck), every meditation spot (Positive Mental Attitude), $250,000 laundered (Dime on the Dollar), $100,000 spent (Treat Yo Self), and all garages (Little Boxes).

roadmap.title: Mop-up and 100%
roadmap.detail: Sweep anything left on the in-game stat page for A Long Road (100% Completion), then watch Vice Got a Price! pop. Expected total: roughly 90-125 hours.
